scenario.topic: Decide on a dog breed suitable for the shared apartment

options.name: French Bulldog
options.upside: Requires minimal exercise and adapts well to apartment life.
options.concern: Prone to breathing issues that may require special care.

options.name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
options.upside: Enjoys companionship and is good with multiple caretakers.
options.concern: Needs regular grooming and moderate daily exercise.

options.name: Shih Tzu
options.upside: Quiet and well-suited for indoor living with low exercise needs.
options.concern: Coat requires consistent grooming to prevent matting.

options.name: Boston Terrier
options.upside: Easily trained and enjoys moderate playtime indoors.
options.concern: Can be prone to separation anxiety if left alone too long.

shared_context: Four roommates are choosing a dog breed suitable for their shared apartment. The breed must adapt well to indoor living, be moderately active, and have a temperament compatible with multiple adults sharing care responsibilities.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 27-year-old graphic designer who values sociability and shared responsibilities.
personas.private_goal: Find a friendly dog that gets along well with multiple caretakers and fits apartment life.

A.reason_for: Adapts well to apartment life and requires minimal exercise.
A.reason_against: Breathing issues could complicate care among roommates.

B.reason_for: Friendly and sociable temperament suits multiple caretakers well.

C.reason_for: Low energy and quiet nature fit indoor living.
C.reason_against: Grooming needs might be a burden for shared care.

D.reason_for: Friendly and intelligent, easily trained for shared care.
D.reason_against: Separation anxiety could be an issue if roommates have varying schedules.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a 32-year-old software engineer who prefers low-maintenance pets due to a busy schedule.
personas.private_goal: Choose a dog that requires minimal grooming and exercise but is still affectionate.

A.reason_for: Low energy and minimal exercise make it easy to care for.
A.reason_against: Health concerns with breathing may require extra attention.

B.reason_for: Friendly and sociable, good with multiple caretakers.
B.reason_against: Regular grooming and exercise are time-consuming.

C.reason_for: Quiet, low energy, and low shedding with manageable grooming needs.

D.reason_for: Low shedding and moderate energy fit apartment life.
D.reason_against: Separation anxiety could be problematic with varied roommate schedules.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a 24-year-old graduate student who values intelligence and moderate activity in a pet.
personas.private_goal: Find a dog that is easy to train and enjoys indoor playtime without too much grooming.

A.reason_for: Calm and affectionate, good for indoor living.
A.reason_against: Health issues might complicate care in a shared environment.

B.reason_for: Friendly and sociable, fits well with multiple caretakers.
B.reason_against: Needs regular grooming and moderate exercise.

C.reason_against: Grooming needs and less playful temperament don't match preference for activity.

D.reason_for: Friendly, intelligent, and enjoys moderate indoor playtime.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a 29-year-old marketing specialist who prioritizes calm and low-exercise pets for apartment living.
personas.private_goal: Select a dog that is affectionate but requires minimal exercise and adapts well indoors.

A.reason_for: Minimal exercise needs and good adaptation to apartment life.

B.reason_against: Moderate exercise and grooming needs are less ideal.

C.reason_for: Gentle and adaptable with low exercise needs.
C.reason_against: Grooming requirements could be a shared responsibility challenge.

D.reason_for: Friendly and intelligent with moderate energy suitable for indoors.
D.reason_against: Separation anxiety risk if left alone too long.
